Header colour themes. Default is solid purple. Choices are saved on this device.

Admin · Access matrix expand

Tick which functional roles may use each app feature. Saved on this device until Azure Entra ID.

Autodesk ACC

Sign in with your Autodesk account to list ACC hubs/projects, import a project into Atana, and sync Docs. Create an APS app at aps.autodesk.com with this exact callback URL.

Load APS credentials from SharePoint

Restricted library (only intended users). Default path can be changed. Uses Microsoft sign-in + Graph — secrets stay out of the GitHub repo.

Separate from APS. Register a SPA app in Entra ID with redirect = this site. API permission: Microsoft Graph Files.Read.All or Sites.Read.All (admin consent).

Default: AtanaIM/Data/aps-config.json on the IM Team site. Change if your library path differs.

Opens the shared Data folder so you can download aps-config.json if automatic load is unavailable.

No Azure AD admin? Use Browse / import after downloading the JSON from the SharePoint folder (Edge SSO works on SharePoint).

aps-config.json format 
{
  "apsClientId": "…",
  "apsClientSecret": "…",
  "apsRegion": "EMEA",
  "apsCallbackUrl": "https://…/app.html"
}

Your ACC is on the EMEA server — this must stay on EMEA or hubs stay empty.

In aps.autodesk.com → your app → Callback URLs, add this exact value (and keep Client Type = Traditional Web App / confidential if you use a secret). Common Autodesk “Request error” = callback not listed or does not match character-for-character.

Data backup

Task list (IM WBS template)

Export hierarchy to Excel, edit offline, import to update. Applies to all projects.

CURRENT WORK STAGE

Progress by subsection

IM Planner — stages follow the project’s SA or RIBA labels. Tasks ordered by dependency. Auto-schedule: single-resource waterfall on 8h days, Mon–Fri.

WBS export & stage dates

Download the scheduled WBS or adjust stage start/end dates.

Task list / WBS by role

Export or import a role task list. WBS codes are role-prefixed (IM-…, DTL-…). Prefer CSV on phone Excel.

Clash schedule

Priority sequence from the project clash matrix (Revizto-aligned). Drag rows to re-order priority. A = to resolve · B = fixed.

MIDP · work stage tracking
Digital Plan of Work

Ss systems encapsulate what is modelled (later: Revit families/models). Set LOD/LOI per stage. Contractual offtake is the imported MIDP plan (MIDP tracking); each task team TIDP is that plan filtered by role, tied to the end of the work stage.

MIDP Generator
Master Information Delivery Plan · linked to this project. Catalogue fields are set under Edit project.

MIDP Tool — register is stored on this project. Project code, originator, functional / spatial codes and disciplines are managed in Edit project; here you only select which are active for generation.

ISO number only — status, work stage and revision are tracked per deliverable, not embedded in the name.
